title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 07 - Infinite HP

preimages.meaning: 中文：禁止伤害计算后的常规当前 HP 写回。 / English: Suppress the normal current-HP writeback after damage calculation.
中文：禁止超量伤害路径把当前 HP 强制写为 0。 / English: Suppress the lethal-damage path that clamps current HP to zero.

known_risks: 中文：同时停止常规 HP 写回与超量伤害的致死归零写回；治疗时当前 HP 也可能保持不变。该 PPC 行为强于源 3DS 单指令补丁，3DS 版能否承受超量伤害尚未实机确认。 / English: Stops both normal HP writeback and the lethal zero-clamp for overkill damage; healing may also leave current HP unchanged. This PPC behavior is stronger than the source 3DS one-instruction patch, whose overkill behavior has not been confirmed on hardware.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #7“HP 无限”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #7 "Infinite HP" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
